comments.author: @Jarle.Jensen
comments.text: I'm from Bergen and there are many nice things about Norway, but this is a glossy picture. I never see it come up in these videos about how badly we treat the elderly in old people's homes and nursing homes when it comes to food, care and time spent with the elderly. This does not happen everywhere, but many more than one would think. 350 thousand of those of working age are on disability. There is a growing problem with youth crime, especially in Oslo where they are recruited by gangs from Norway and Sweden. We have very little innovation, becaus  the government makes it difficult with high taxes and a lot of bureaucracy. We also have more and more people living below the poverty line while food is only  is getting more and more expensive.
